frontmatter.name: graphify
frontmatter.description: Use for any question about a codebase, its architecture, file relationships, or project content — especially when graphify-out/ exists, where the question should be treated as a graphify query first. Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.

nodes.label: Band2Midi (ongoing Python interoperability project)
nodes.rationale: Extract user-created musical information from GarageBand projects into a widely supported format; support for project structures may be incomplete.

nodes.label: .dawproject (possible future output representation)
nodes.rationale: Additional interoperability representation mentioned as a possibility where technically feasible; this README does not claim implemented support.

nodes.label: Processing legitimately accessible user-supplied project data
nodes.norm_label: processing legitimately accessible user-supplied project data
nodes.rationale: The stated scope is user-supplied project data legitimately accessible to the user; bypassing protection, authentication, or licensing and redistributing Apple software or assets are excluded.

nodes.label: Controlled project-file experiments
nodes.rationale: Compare projects with known musical contents to identify the binary representation of individual parameters and support independent parser implementation.

nodes.label: Independent implementation
nodes.rationale: Implement parsing from controlled project-file analysis without containing or depending on GarageBand or Apple source, executable binaries, proprietary libraries, frameworks, or audio assets.

nodes.label: Musical-project interoperability and portability
nodes.rationale: Allow user-created musical information to move beyond the application that originally stored it.

nodes.label: Independent project-data parser
nodes.rationale: Analyze project data and translate musical information without requiring Apple implementation or source code.
